code_style: AI-code. AI-generated model inputs with primary references.
physics_scope: Exclusive vector radiative source benchmarks; all native vector parent masses remain zero-width pole approximations. Propagator widths below concern the virtual electromagnetic transition only. No claim of complete meson physics or calibrated absolute parent production.

parents.name: phi

transition_form_factor.validity_note: Published finite-width rho VMD benchmark, not the full dispersive calculation of this reference. Keeps F(0)=1 and the physical rho width; its discrepancy from KLOE bins is tested and recorded. Native phi mass remains a pole source. No arbitrary rescaling of the measured-bin central values.

parents.qualification_scope: Published running-width rho VMD benchmark, checked against KLOE Table1 and integrated phi-pi0 Dalitz branching fraction. Full dispersive amplitude and vector-source mass/spin uncertainties remain unresolved.

measured_transition_validation.validity_note: Measured finite bin averages are used as a piecewise constant benchmark, not pointwise measurements; the last .55-.7 GeV bin is broad. No extrapolation above .7 GeV and no singular fit-pole near .704 GeV. Bin errors combine statistical and systematic uncertainties, covariance unavailable.

parents.name: rho0

transition_form_factor.validity_note: Published tree-level chiral resonance model, normalized at zero. SigmaV=0.58 is a fit to old NA60 omega-pi data; its fit error/covariance and SU3-breaking model uncertainty are unavailable. The listed coupling-input envelope is not a full theory uncertainty.

parents.qualification_scope: Published rho0-pi0 chiral TFF benchmark; broad physical rho spectrum and spin alignment not yet modeled.

parents.qualification_scope: Explicit isospin extension of rho0-pi0 normalized chiral TFF to charged rho-pi; measured charged radiative BR. Charged timelike shape and broad parent spectra unvalidated.
parents.mass_convention: PDG 2025 charged rho tau/e+e- pole benchmark .77511 GeV; the separate hadroproduction average .7665 GeV is not used. Native source mass-shape uncertainty remains unresolved.

parents.name: kstar0

transition_form_factor.validity_note: Published single-rho VMD benchmark, using the finite-width propagator from Eq2, normalized as a complex amplitude at zero. Unlike Eq3 zero-width simplification, it remains finite through the rho pole. Pole-source endpoint is below .4 GeV so the resonance is not sampled. Neither strange-transition SU3 coefficients nor model discrepancy are measured; this is not a precision prediction.

parents.qualification_scope: Theoretical finite-width single-rho VMD benchmark with measured radiative BR, explicit charge conjugates. Broad Kstar mass spectrum and multiple-vector interference unvalidated.
